name: dvga
notes:
UNVERIFIED in this build environment: there is no network here to pull the image or confirm the port/health path at runtime; the operator must verify on a networked host. Canonical image source: Docker Hub `dolevf/dvga` (Damn Vulnerable GraphQL Application by Dolev Farhi). Run example: `docker run -t -p 5013:5013 -e WEB_HOST=0.0.0.0 dolevf/dvga`. WEB_HOST=0.0.0.0 is REQUIRED so the Flask app binds all interfaces (it otherwise binds loopback and is unreachable from outside the container). No DB companion needed (uses an internal SQLite store seeded at startup). Web UI and GraphiQL are unauthenticated.

App shape / how to exercise it: the real attack surface is POST /graphql with a JSON body `{"query": "..."}` (GraphiQL IDE at /graphiql; introspection and field-suggestions are enabled by default in the beginner/easy difficulty mode). The web UI root `/` returns 200 and is fine as a health/seed path, but a generic crawler will mostly see the HTML UI — to actually reach the vulnerable resolvers the scanner must construct valid GraphQL operations and fuzz argument values (JSON_VALUE into GraphQL variables/args). DVGA also exposes a difficulty toggle: in expert/hard mode introspection, field suggestions, and some protections are disabled/hardened, which changes behavior — assume default beginner mode.

Ground truth = "none" (co-design decision, honest): DVGA is deliberately vulnerable, but I am NOT confident a generic HTTP DAST maps to STABLE, reproducible bug LOCATIONS here without GraphQL-aware query construction — inserting payloads into the `query` string value typically corrupts GraphQL syntax rather than reaching a specific resolver, so a curated recall manifest would be guesswork and is intentionally omitted. We therefore measure false-positive count, discovery, and performance rather than recall. For operator reference, DVGA's documented (but un-curated) vulnerability surface includes: OS command injection (systemDiagnostics / SystemDebug operation, cmd/username args -> command_injection), SQL injection (pastes filter and readAndBurn `id` arg -> sqli), SSRF (importPaste host/port/path/scheme -> ssrf; would benefit from an OOB collector, hence enable_oob is left false by default and should be turned on with a collector to hunt it), stored/reflected XSS (createPaste content rendered later -> xss), GraphQL DoS (deeply nested / batched queries), and information disclosure via enabled introspection, field suggestions, and exposed GraphiQL (-> exposure). These labels reflect OUR knowledge of DVGA and are well-documented upstream, but are stable-should-be-verified and were deliberately NOT encoded as curated ground truth because reliable black-box location-level detection by this scanner is uncertain.
